name: genqammod
expr: y8  = genqammod(xrt, const8); z8 = genqamdemod(y8, const8); yPam = genqammod((0:3)', constReal); zPam = genqamdemod(yPam, constReal); yNoisy = genqamdemod(y8 + 0.05*(1+1i), const8);
comment: MATLAB genqammod / genqamdemod: integer-input lookup into a user-supplied constellation, demod = nearest-neighbour. Covered: 8-PSK constellation forward+round-trip, real PAM constellation, noisy demod still picks correct neighbour. Bit-input mode (`'InputType','bit'`) deferred -- documented. Octave 11.1.0 doesn't ship genqammod in core (signal/communications package only); reports N/A.
